title: Iran Goldstein de-escalation vs ITA (short)
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Reversal control: Iran GDELT Goldstein 20d z-score > 1 (de-escalation) leads defense ETF returns by 1-3 days (-); trade short ITA 1d [gdelt.irn.goldstein -> finance.ITA.log_return] (parent: R2-0080)
message: Not supported: r=0.11 at lag 0 (n=390); short-ITA rule on Goldstein z>1 loses (54 trades, hit 37%, avg -0.45%, Sharpe-like -2.1; OOS 18 trades avg -0.09%) - de-escalation does not predict ITA weakness

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.goldstein rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short ITA next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Sign flip of R2-0179: Iran GDELT Goldstein 20d z-score > 1 (de-escalation) is followed by positive defense ETF returns within 1-2 days (+); trade long ITA 1d [gdelt.irn.goldstein -> finance.ITA.log_return] (parent: R2-0179)
